description.fun: Celebi, the 'Voice of the Forest', can travel through time, and plants flourish wherever it has been. It only shows itself in peaceful times, and it's said that as long as it's still being seen, the future will be bright. It was nearly the secret inside the anime's mysterious GS Ball, until it was given a movie of its own instead.
description.guide: A Psychic- and Grass-type Mythical Pokémon, the guardian of Ilex Forest and the last entry in the Johto Pokédex. It can travel through time, and plants thrive wherever it goes. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A time-travelling forest spirit that only appears in peaceful times
